abstract: The invention relates to a device (1) for gripping and transporting substrates, in particular wafers, circuit boards, solar cells or similar, with a gripping head (2) having at least one contact surface (29) for applying to a substrate and at least one suction device for suctioning the substrate against the contact surface (29), wherein the suction device has multiple vacuum chambers (10, 11, 12) which can be supplied with a negative pressure, and which are/can be fluidically connected to suction openings (22) associated with the contact surface (29), and which are separated from one another in the longitudinal direction of the gripping head (2).
